lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Perform a bitwise operation between two binary numbers.
Input
op a b: A bitwise operator, followed by two binary numbers.
Output
A decimal number, result of the bitwise operation.
Constraints
Possible values of op: AND, OR, XOR, NAND, NOR, XNOR.
0 ≤ a < 2^31
0 ≤ b < 2^31
a and b always have the same number of digits.
a and b can have leading zeros so that lengths match.
Example
Input
OR 11 00
Output
3
